blurb: Located on the Kentucky River in Downtown Frankfort behind the Old Federal Building and Paul Sawyer Library, the 150-year-old Boat Club is a private dock owned, operated and maintained by its members and is home to Kentucky River Tours, “The Bourbon Belle” and “The Trace of Kentucky”.
